title: LAF-ECG: Multi-Resolution Lead-Aware Fusion of Time-Series and Language Foundation Models for ECG Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.29721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation has advanced substantially with deep learning, yet many methods remain task-specific and label-dependent. Large language models (LLMs) and time-series foundation models (TSFMs) offer complementary pretrained representations, but integrating them is challenging because of mismatched feature spaces and the lead- and scale-dependent structure of ECG signals. We propose LAF-ECG (Lead-Aware Foundation Fusion for ECG), a dual-foundation framework that extends MedTsLLM with a lead-aware interface to a frozen TSFM backbone while retaining its reprogramming pathway. The proposed framework captures multi-resolution temporal context, fuses temporal and language-aligned ECG representations through adaptive residual integration, and employs branch-specific supervision with cross-branch alignment. LAF-ECG achieves 71.10% accuracy and 62.43% macro-F1 on PTB-XL, and 89.73% accuracy and 65.94% macro-F1 on

translated_title: LAF-ECG：面向心电图分类的时间序列与语言基础模型的多分辨率导联感知融合
translated_abstract: 随着深度学习的发展，自动化心电图（ECG）解读已取得长足进步，但许多方法仍然依赖于特定任务且依赖标注数据。大型语言模型（LLM）和时间序列基础模型（TSFM）提供了互补的预训练表示，但由于特征空间不匹配以及ECG信号本身具有的导联和尺度相关结构，将二者整合存在挑战。我们提出了LAF-ECG（面向心电图的导联感知基础模型融合），这是一个双基础模型框架，它扩展了MedTsLLM，添加了一个导联感知接口连接至冻结的TSFM骨干网络，同时保留其重编程路径。所提出的框架捕获多分辨率时间上下文，通过自适应残差集成融合时间对齐和语言对齐的ECG表示，并采用分支特定监督与跨分支对齐机制。LAF-ECG在PTB-XL数据集上达到71.10%的准确率和62.43%的宏F1分数，并在另一数据集上达到89.73%的准确率和65.94%的宏F1分数。
tldr: LAF-ECG提出了一种导联感知的双基础模型融合框架，通过融合冻结的时间序列基础模型与大型语言模型的多分辨率表示，并在多个数据集上显著提升了心电图分类性能。
en_tdlr: LAF-ECG proposes a lead-aware dual-foundation fusion framework that integrates multi-resolution representations from a frozen time-series foundation model and a large language model, achieving superior performance on ECG classification across multiple datasets.
